scope: Exact sealed inert observed/public adapters and full deltas against C39; no helper or product execution.

producerSemantics.firstGrant: Actual first checkpoint result, signature/token match and actual ledger booleans/error count are prerequisites before requested claim facts.
producerSemantics.storedClaims: Requested backdate is ceil(first genTime - accuracy - 300000) - 1; postdate is first genTime + 86400000. Actual persisted row timestamps, distinct identities and ordered positions are retained.
producerSemantics.queryProofs: Each retained grant maps to its own checkpoint digest, actual request query/response and exact verification child argv. Token pins are compared when present. Two retained grants must share the owned anchor and signer.
producerSemantics.covered: Complete acceptance additionally requires the actual second head, ordered covered row indices, two signed checkpoint/token pins, checkpoint ledger-row metadata, both actual ledger verification positives and independent bound premises.
producerSemantics.readerAndFinal: The reader must receive actual stored timestamps and return BACKDATED_CLAIM/POSTDATED_CLAIM with the genuine attested window. Complete acceptance also requires final event/file nonmutation and actual ledger verification positives.
producerSemantics.redBoundary: Absent producer setup or later fields receive no credit; reached actual booleans and nonzero ledger error counts remain observations. Root must classify every real failure and masked later assertion.

provenance.prepared175RowsAnd12Natives: Verified by the immediately preceding sealed source-scope snapshot. This adapter review does not claim a continuous fresh physical-pin check or adopt future runtime successors.
provenance.rootOnly: Root owns source allocation, current runtime pins, exact product execution and actual fresh/control results.

limitations: Static text and metadata review only; no Python/TypeScript import, syntax parser, compiler, helper or product execution.
No signing-root, key, child-stream, native payload, SQL or network read/execution was performed. The executor may hash only explicitly named streams under unchanged guards.
